_comment: Single source of truth for pr-loop's waiter addresses and tunables.
wait-for-verdict.sh and verdict-predicate.py were copied verbatim from
reviewer bot. Only this config.json differs: it points at pr-loop's own channel
(#ent-internal) instead of review-loop's #ooolab-be. Do not edit the scripts to

bot_review_channel.name: #ent-internal
bot_review_channel._note: Same channel pr-loop's seed ping and tick replies already use.

loop._note: Same default and meaning as review-loop's: one round = one new-reviewer-message triage-and-reply cycle. Reaching it is a stop-and-report, never a silent exit.
